question: As of July 2025, who is the Chairperson of the Lok Sabha Estimates Committee?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Jaiswal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• The **Chairperson of the Estimates Committee** in the Lok Sabha as of **July 2025** is **Sanjay Jaiswal**, a prominent Member of Parliament and a senior leader from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

• The **Estimates Committee** is one of the three financial committees in the Indian Parliament, tasked with examining budgetary allocations and ensuring efficient use of public resources.

• The committee consists of **30 members**, all of whom are elected from the Lok Sabha (House of the People) based on proportional representation by means of a single transferable vote.

• The Chairperson of the committee is always chosen from the ruling party or alliance in the Lok Sabha to ensure effective coordination between the government and the committee.

• **Sanjay Jaiswal** has been actively involved in parliamentary proceedings and is known for his expertise in financial oversight and governance matters, making him a suitable choice for this role.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Estimates Committee Overview:**

• The Estimates Committee was first constituted in **1950** and is the largest parliamentary committee, consisting of 30 members.

• Its function is to scrutinize the **budget estimates** presented by the government to ensure that expenditure aligns with the principles of economy and efficiency.

• The committee also examines whether the expenditure is within the policy framework approved by Parliament.

• The committee does not question the policy but focuses on its implementation and financial implications.

• **Eligibility and Membership:**

• Only members of the **Lok Sabha** can be part of this committee. Members from the Rajya Sabha are not included.

• The Chairperson is usually a member of the ruling party or coalition, ensuring smooth communication with the executive branch.

• **Sanjay Jaiswal:**

• **Sanjay Jaiswal** is a senior BJP leader and a Member of Parliament from **Paschim Champaran constituency in Bihar**.

• He has been serving as an MP since **2009** and is known for his contributions to parliamentary debates and his leadership roles within the party.

• His experience and expertise in public administration and financial matters make him a trusted leader for overseeing the functioning of the Estimates Committee.

• **Important Functions of the Estimates Committee:**

• To suggest alternative policies for achieving the efficiency and economy in administration.

• To examine whether the money is well laid out within the limits of the policy implied in the estimates.

• To suggest the form in which the estimates shall be presented to Parliament to make them transparent and comprehensible.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Other Financial Committees:**

• The **Public Accounts Committee (PAC)** examines the accounts showing the appropriation of funds and ensures transparency in government spending.

• The **Committee on Public Undertakings (COPU)** reviews the working of public sector enterprises and evaluates their financial performance.

• **Relevance of the Estimates Committee:**

• This committee plays a crucial role in ensuring that government spending is in line with public welfare and economic development goals.

• It acts as a watchdog, holding the executive accountable for its financial decisions and implementation.
